retrieved_synopses: Shadowheart deals with Viconia after she has been defeated. Shadowheart could have come here to lead a coup against Viconia and seize control of the Shar Grotto, or she could have turned from her faith and have come here to rescue her captive parents.

Shadowheart meets with her parents once again, who have been imprisoned for decades. A vision of Shar appears and demands Shadowheart sacrifice her parents.Note: there are two major tracks in this scene - if SH comes to it as a loyal Sharran who is intent on taking control of the church at her goddess's command, or as someone who has turned from Shar and is coming to rescue her parents.

Avatar Shadowheart meets with her parents once again, who have been imprisoned for decades. A vision of Shar appears and demands Shadowheart sacrifice her parents.Note: there are two major tracks in this scene - if SH comes to it as a loyal Sharran who is intent on taking control of the church at her goddess's command, or as someone who has turned from Shar and is coming to rescue her parents.

Shadowheart confronts Viconia about her past and potentially the leadership of the cult itself. Alternatively, she may be here to free her parents, if she has abandoned Shar. The player can support her efforts and help her defeat Viconia, or else betray her.

context: Viconia has been defeated and Shadowheart is confronting her for answers about Shadowheart’s past and the fate of her long‑imprisoned parents. Viconia claims she was Shadowheart’s mentor — forced by Lady Shar to mold and groom Shadowheart (even razing an enclave in Waterdeep) — and taunts that Shadowheart’s parents are held in the Chamber of Loss. Off‑screen, Shadowheart’s parents have been prisoners for decades and a vision of Shar may later demand their sacrifice; the scene can follow one of two major tracks: Shadowheart as a loyal Sharran seeking to seize leadership of the grotto, or Shadowheart who has abandoned Shar and is rushing to rescue her parents. The player and companions can influence whether Viconia is killed, questioned, or left alive as Shadowheart goes to see her parents.
